newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares helped higher by Droga.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares helped higher by Droga.

text.p: Slovenian shares firmed one percent on Wednesday, pulled up by food maker Droga, and dealers forecast selective demand would characterise trade in the short term.
"Food and drug producers are the most interesting shares on this market due to their good business performance and future outlook," one trader said.
* The SBI index rose 13.18 points to 1,318.96.
* Food producer Droga was the top gainer, firming 1.78 percent to 28,000 tolars on volume of 49 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
